redaction.$comment: Plan 070 Task 9 network-free redaction scenario. Fixture: one transcript-scale string (>=1 MiB, 16 realistic secret-shaped needles, each present) plus a small entry-shaped object. minSpeedup is a same-process ratio (shipped single scan vs the ordered reduce/split/join it replaced), so it travels across machines; the p95 ceilings are non-flaky sanity bounds. Recorded 2026-09-11 Node v24.19.0/Linux x64 (speedup 12). Plan 124 Task 4 re-measured it on Bun 1.4.2 (2026-09-25, load/cpu 0.24-0.45) and found the ratio's *method* was the problem, not the floor: measured sequentially the two phases see different contention (Bun's single scan is the more contention-sensitive side), which put Bun's min at 3.37 and inside the floor. The scenario now interleaves the two phases per iteration (the src/__tests__/field-policy.test.ts A/B method), and the ratio is stable across idle and loaded runs: Bun min-of-25 6.95 / p50 8.1 (10 idle, 10 with three gate files running concurrently, 5 more idle), same-session Node 9.5-11.3. The floor stays 5 = Bun min x 0.72: a reintroduced ordered loop (ratio -> 1) or a 1.4x single-scan regression still fails.
